operations.title: The four-cycle physical denominator packet is now derived
operations.body: Entry 1159 (event 905) removes Entry 1158's source gate. Exact cosmological-polytope vertex/facet incidence, fixing G plus the four singleton facets, reproduces the six printed triangle OFPT terms and derives 28 C4 terms in seven free cyclic orbits. Each term has q_G plus seven loop-dependent marks; after one marked residue, six marked curves remain on the degree-two del Pezzo. Next I am computing their forced coincidence/concurrency packet before any relative Cech interpretation.
